## 카테고리와 evidence 매핑

아래 가중치는 P: 초기 정책이다. 실제 observation이 없는 경우 해당 evidence는 missing이며 대체 지수를 만들어 넣지 않는다.

| 카테고리 | evidence ID와 초기 비중 | 해석 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| coding_repo | swe_verified_exact 0.6, aa_coding 0.4 | exact는 실제 프로필의 비교 가능한 평가만; AA는 모델 proxy |
| terminal_ops | terminal_exact 0.7, aa_coding 0.3 | Terminal 버전을 설정에 고정 |
| code_gen | aa_coding 1.0 | 일반 생성에 webdev를 자동 포함하지 않음 |
| webdev | arena_webdev 0.6, aa_coding 0.4 | 웹 개발 작업일 때만 해당 Arena 사용 |
| math_reasoning | arena_text_math 1.0 | 실제 category 존재 확인 후 사용; 없으면 제약 만족 default |
| analysis | aa_intelligence 0.6, arena_text 0.4 | 일반 proxy, 조사 도구 능력은 별도 hard capability |
| writing | arena_text 1.0 | 언어/스타일 적합성은 실작업에서 확인 |
| vision_doc | arena_document 0.5, arena_vision 0.5 | 이미지/PDF 처리 capability도 반드시 필터 |
| general | aa_intelligence 1.0 | 광범위 proxy |

categories.toml에 evidence mapping과 weights를 두며 각 카테고리 내 합은 1이다. 모델 proxy evidence는 scope=model_proxy, exact evidence는 scope=exact_profile로 표시한다. 모델 proxy에 “하네스 할인 0.9”를 붙여 Terminal/SWE 결측을 채우지 않는다.

실제 exact 데이터가 드물면 coding_repo/terminal_ops의 coverage가 낮아 default로 갈 수 있다. 이것은 초기 설계의 정직한 한계다. curated exact snapshot을 추가하거나 평가된 다른 proxy 정책을 명시적으로 도입하기 전에는 “벤치마크 기반 최적 Agent”라는 표현을 쓰지 않는다.

## 정규화

같은 benchmark cohort의 비교 가능한 전체 모델/프로필을 기준으로 계산한다. 활성 후보만 바뀌었다고 percentile 기준을 바꾸지 않는다. 높은 값이 좋도록 direction을 적용한 뒤:

normalized = (average_rank_ascending - 1) / (N - 1)

tie는 평균 rank이고 N=1이면 0.5로 둔다. 범위는 0~1. cohort ID·N·raw·metric·source revision을 저장한다. 95% CI를 제공하면 원본 그대로 보관하지만 percentile을 성공확률/CI로 해석하지 않는다.

percentile은 점수 간 실제 크기 차이를 지운다는 한계가 있다. v1은 비교 척도 통일을 위한 정책으로 사용하고 별도 calibrated 모델 없이 직접 success probability로 변환하지 않는다.

## 제약과 가용성

> 2026-10-13: 제약은 `routing.CONSTRAINTS`의 이름 붙은 검사이며, 통과·실패 모두 관측값·기준값과 함께 기록된다. Orchestrator context의 비용 상한·필요 컨텍스트도 같은 제약이다. 다중 기준 계약은 `docs/routing-contracts.md` §3.

먼저 enabled, 지원 kind, 실제 executable/인증 준비, exclude_profiles, cost_tier, context, modality/tools, local_only를 적용한다. 지원 capability가 unknown이면 해당 capability가 요구된 후보는 제외한다.

cost tier 순서: low < medium < high. 이는 상대 정책이고 monetary budget 보장이 아니다. min_context_tokens는 작업·도구·예상 응답을 포함한 요구치이며 Free API 누락값을 무한대로 간주하지 않는다. live route에서 준비 안 된 프로필은 제외하고, offline dry-run은 availability_unverified를 표시한다.

local_only는 로컬 inference/처리를 뜻한다. herdr가 로컬에서 실행된다고 cloud 모델이 local_only를 충족하는 것은 아니다.

## 점수 계산

> 2026-10-13부터 이 절과 아래 선택 규칙은 **legacy 자동 route 정책**이다(`route`를 `--selection` 없이 쓸 때). evaluate 2.0에서는 `evaluations.benchmark.legacy_score`로만 보이며 종합 순위가 아니다. 최종 선택은 Orchestrator 몫이다(`docs/routing-contracts.md` §1).

카테고리 분포 w와 mapping 비중 v로 evidence별 총 가중치 a_b = Σ_c(w_c × v_cb)를 구한다. 유효 evidence 집합을 A_p라 할 때:

C_p = Σ_(b in A_p) a_b
Q_obs(p) = Σ_(b in A_p) a_b × normalized_pb / C_p     (C_p > 0)
Q(p) = C_p × Q_obs(p) + (1-C_p) × 0.5 - 0.1 × (1-C_p)

결측에는 prior 0.5와 penalty 0.1을 둔다. 이는 P이며 데이터가 없는 점수를 관측치라고 기록하지 않는다. normalized 0점도 coverage에 포함한다.

- 후보 중 C >= 0.5인 프로필이 있으면 그 집합만 score ranking한다.
- 모두 C < 0.5이면 제약 만족 default를 선택하고 selection_mode=default_insufficient_evidence로 기록한다. default가 제외됐다면 명시 configured fallback_order의 첫 eligible 프로필을 쓴다. 아무것도 없으면 종료한다.
- coverage_band: sufficient(C>=0.8), partial(0.5<=C<0.8), insufficient(C<0.5).
- coverage와 exact_profile evidence 비중은 별도 보고한다. sufficient가 “실제 Agent 성공 확신 높음”을 뜻하지 않는다.

S(p) = Q(p) - lambda_cost × cost_proxy(p)

고정 tier proxy는 low=0, medium=0.5, high=1. quality lambda=0, balanced=0.15, cost=0.30. 후보 집합 min-max 정규화는 쓰지 않아 무관한 후보 제거가 남은 후보 점수에 영향을 주지 않는다. API token price를 이 tier 값으로 몰래 치환하지 않는다.

MVP의 latency penalty와 warm bonus는 0이다. 측정 없는 모델 TTFT를 Agent 전체 지연으로 사용하지 않는다. 이후 실행별 latency와 reuse 정책이 준비되면 policy version을 올려 추가한다.

top score와 차이가 0.02 미만인 후보는 near-tie 집합으로 보고, 낮은 cost tier → profile ID 사전순으로 선택한다. quality priority에서는 비용으로 near-tie를 뒤집지 않고 정확한 score 내림차순 → ID로 결정한다. 차이가 정확히 0.02면 near-tie에 포함하지 않는다. float tolerance와 정렬 규칙을 fixture에 고정한다.

정렬은 eligible snapshot·availability·config·task가 같을 때 결정적이다. Agent 가용성이 달라져도 항상 같은 선택이라고 보장하지 않는다.

## 합성 기대값

examples/scoring.synthetic.json의 비중은 b1=0.6, b2=0.4이다.

| 프로필 | 점수 b1/b2 | coverage | Q | tier proxy | balanced S |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| synthetic-a | 0.9 / 0.8 | 1.0 | 0.86 | 1.0 | 0.710 |
| synthetic-b | 0.95 / missing | 0.6 | 0.73 | 0.0 | 0.730 |
| synthetic-c | 0.85 / 0.85 | 1.0 | 0.85 | 0.5 | 0.775 |

balanced 선택은 synthetic-c, quality는 synthetic-a, cost는 synthetic-b다. 모두 합성 값이며 실제 모델 점수·가격과 관계없다.

# P: 초기 정책. 값을 바꾸면 POLICY_VERSION을 올린다.
POLICY = {
    "coverage_threshold": 0.5,
    "missing_prior": 0.5,
    "missing_penalty": 0.1,
    "near_tie_epsilon": 0.02,
    "tier_proxy": {"low": 0.0, "medium": 0.5, "high": 1.0},
    "lambda_cost": {"quality": 0.0, "balanced": 0.15, "cost": 0.30},
    "l0_min_confidence": 0.6,
}

TASK_REQUIRED = ("schema_version", "task_id", "round", "summary", "prompt", "cwd")
TASK_OPTIONAL = ("context_files", "categories", "category_confidence", "constraints", "priority", "exclude_profiles",
                 "facets")
CONSTRAINT_DEFAULTS = {"max_cost_tier": "high", "min_context_tokens": 0, "local_only": False,
                       "timeout_ms": 900000, "required_capabilities": []}
TASK_MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024


# ---------- context.json: Orchestrator 공급 지표 (docs/routing-contracts.md §2) ----------

CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION = "2.0"
EVALUATE_SCHEMA_VERSION = "2.0"
ROUTER_COST_SOURCE = "router:io2-v1"
METRIC_REGISTRY_VERSION = "1"
# 지표 정의표. 단위·대상·수명 검증이 필요한 새 지표는 여기에 한 줄 추가한다.
# 선호 방향(클수록 좋다 등)은 정책이므로 두지 않는다. 의미·단위를 바꾸면 METRIC_REGISTRY_VERSION을 올린다.
# id: (applies_to task|profile, kind int|number|bool|enum:a|b, unit|None, max_age_hours|None)
METRICS = {
    "tokens.estimated_input": ("profile", "int", "tokens", None),
    "tokens.estimated_output": ("profile", "int", "tokens", None),
    "tokens.required_context": ("profile", "int", "tokens", None),
    "price.input_usd_per_mtok": ("profile", "number", "usd/mtok", 24 * 30),
    "price.output_usd_per_mtok": ("profile", "number", "usd/mtok", 24 * 30),
    "cost.estimated_usd": ("profile", "number", "usd", None),
    "task.complexity": ("task", "enum:low|medium|high", None, None),
}
METRIC_KEYS = {"value", "unit", "source", "observed_at", "expires_at", "status", "reason"}
COST_INPUTS = ("tokens.estimated_input", "tokens.estimated_output", "price.input_usd_per_mtok", "price.output_usd_per_mtok")

def context_facts(profile, context, now):
    """(정확한 Decimal 비용 | None, 1.0 출력용 facts, 지표+freshness). 제약 판단은 CONSTRAINTS가 한다.
    결측·만료 값은 계산에 쓰지 않는다(0이 아니다)."""
    raw = context["profiles"].get(profile["id"], {}).get("metrics", {})
    metrics = metric_facts(raw, now)
    usable = {k: m["value"] for k, m in metrics.items() if k in METRICS and m["freshness"] == "fresh"}
    cost, missing = None, None
    if "cost.estimated_usd" in usable:  # Orchestrator 견적(캐시·부가 비용 포함 가능)이 계산보다 우선
        cost = Decimal(str(usable["cost.estimated_usd"]))
    elif all(k in usable for k in COST_INPUTS):  # ponytail: 입출력 2요율 식 1개. 그 이상은 견적으로 받는다
        cost = (Decimal(usable["tokens.estimated_input"]) * Decimal(str(usable["price.input_usd_per_mtok"]))
                + Decimal(usable["tokens.estimated_output"]) * Decimal(str(usable["price.output_usd_per_mtok"]))) / 1_000_000
    else:
        missing = ("price_expired" if any(metrics.get(k, {}).get("freshness") == "expired" for k in COST_INPUTS)
                   else "estimate_or_price_missing")
    if "cost.estimated_usd" not in usable and (cost is not None or "cost.estimated_usd" not in metrics):
        metrics["cost.estimated_usd"] = (
            {"value": float(cost), "unit": "usd", "source": ROUTER_COST_SOURCE, "status": "ok", "freshness": "fresh"}
            if cost is not None else
            {"status": "missing", "reason": missing, "source": ROUTER_COST_SOURCE, "freshness": "missing"})
    pin, pout = raw.get("price.input_usd_per_mtok", {}), raw.get("price.output_usd_per_mtok", {})
    price = ({"input_usd_per_million_tokens": pin["value"], "output_usd_per_million_tokens": pout["value"],
              "source": pin["source"], "as_of": pin.get("observed_at")} if "value" in pin and "value" in pout else None)
    facts = {"estimated_cost_usd": float(cost) if cost is not None else None,
             "cost_missing_reason": missing, "required_context_tokens": usable.get("tokens.required_context", 0),
             "estimated_input_tokens": usable.get("tokens.estimated_input"),
             "estimated_output_tokens": usable.get("tokens.estimated_output"),
             "price": price, "signals": {k: m for k, m in raw.items() if k not in METRICS}}
    return cost, facts, metrics

# P: 초기 정책 (03 문서 "카테고리와 evidence 매핑"). 각 카테고리 합 = 1.
# 바꾸면 routing.POLICY_VERSION도 올린다.
[mapping.coding_repo]
swe_verified_exact = 0.6
aa_coding = 0.4

[mapping.terminal_ops]
terminal_exact = 0.7
aa_coding = 0.3

[mapping.code_gen]
aa_coding = 1.0

[mapping.webdev]
arena_webdev = 0.6
aa_coding = 0.4

[mapping.math_reasoning]
arena_text_math = 1.0

[mapping.analysis]
aa_intelligence = 0.6
arena_text = 0.4

[mapping.writing]
arena_text = 1.0

[mapping.vision_doc]
arena_document = 0.5
arena_vision = 0.5

[mapping.general]
aa_intelligence = 1.0

- `profiles.toml`, Herdr, herdr-projects 1.2.1 and the target agent CLI must already be configured for live dispatch on Linux/WSL2. The task `cwd` must be the top level of a git repository with a commit. Profile `args` may only carry a model (`--model`/`-m`) and an effort; agent permissions follow the board's `worker.access` setting. See [Projects setup](../../docs/projects.md). Run `python scripts/cli.py status` to inspect snapshot health. See the [reference](../../docs/reference.md) for setup and command contracts.

## Delegate and recover

Use the [cheap decision workflow](references/decision.md) for semantic facets and final profile selection: Jev when `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` (or `JEV_API_KEY`) is set, otherwise the host's native `bench-decider` (Antigravity Flash, Codex GPT-6 Luna, Claude Code Haiku). Pass the current host through `scripts/decide.py --host antigravity|codex|claude`; `BENCH_ROUTER_DECISION_MODEL` overrides its model. Read that reference before choosing; the helper implements provider detection and response validation. Do not send these decisions through Router delegation or recursively invoke this Skill.

1. Create a temporary UTF-8 JSON task file with `schema_version: "1.0"`, a unique `task_id` (UUID hex is suitable), `round: 1`, `summary`, `prompt`, and an existing, trusted absolute `cwd`. Add only relevant optional task fields. Keep the task content and `(task_id, round)` stable for retries; use a new round only after checking the previous run's effects. Remove the temporary file once its CLI output is captured.
   Tag the task's nature in `facets` (`{axis: [value]}`) using only the values listed by `python scripts/cli.py wiki facets`; pick every value that fits the prompt and omit axes that do not apply. The output includes descriptions in `facets` and automatic detection rules in `detection`. Rules inspect language, file types and code blocks, but you can explicitly tag any listed value when a rule misses it (e.g. `task: webdev_react` for a React request without context files). `evidence --task TASK_FILE --format table` then shows matching benchmark results per profile, with task type matches first; an unknown value fails with the allowed list, so correct it from that list. This evidence table does not change the legacy automatic selection made by plain `route`; use `evaluate` and `route --selection` when making an Orchestrator choice from it.
2. Run `python scripts/cli.py route --task TASK_FILE --selection SELECTION_FILE` with the validated decision from the workflow above. Pass global options such as `--herdr-session` before `route` when needed. Read the JSON `status` even when the process exits nonzero, and retain `run_id` and `cwd` for recovery. Add `--dry-run` to validate selection without dispatch. Plain `route` still uses the legacy automatic policy when the caller explicitly requests it.
3. For `blocked`, address the reported approval or question through the normal caller workflow. For `timed_out` or `delivery_uncertain`, run `collect --run-id RUN_ID --cwd CWD --wait-ms N`; never generate a fresh task ID or resend the prompt to resolve uncertainty. For `conflict`, inspect the warning and existing receipt before another dispatch. A completed result means the artifact contract passed, not that the task succeeded.
4. A `completed` run's agent panes are closed automatically so finished agents stop holding resources (`release` in the output; agents still working or blocked are left open). To continue that agent's conversation, run `python scripts/cli.py resume --run-id RUN_ID --cwd CWD`; it reopens the board task's space and restarts the agent in the same session without sending anything.
5. Inspect the returned result and verify the requested work. Record the verified outcome with `feedback --run-id RUN_ID --cwd CWD --outcome success|partial|fail` when there is a run to assess.

## Parallel handoff

# Cheap decision provider

Use the host Orchestrator's native subagent tool for fallback. This helper does not launch a worker or delegate the coding task.

## Provider selection

- `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` (or `JEV_API_KEY`) present: `scripts/decide.py` calls the official Jev endpoint. `JEV_MODEL` overrides the pinned default `jev-1.13.0`. Keys stay in the environment; never include them in task files, prompts, or output. Besides real environment variables, `decide.py` and `refresh` read `JEV_API_KEY`, `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, `JEV_MODEL`, `BENCH_ROUTER_DECISION_MODEL` and `ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY` from `./.env` in the working directory, then `~/.config/bench-router/env`; the process environment wins, and other variables in `.env` are ignored. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`, keep `.env` out of git (`chmod 600`), and carry it to each device through a secret manager or by hand.
- No key, or Jev fails: the helper returns `status: subagent_required` with a bounded decision request. Invoke one native subagent with that request, without inherited conversation history, file writes, tools, or further delegation. It must only return typed answers.
- Pass `--host antigravity`, `--host codex`, or `--host claude` on helper calls. Fallback packets identify the native `bench-decider` and its explicit model using the table below. `BENCH_ROUTER_DECISION_MODEL` overrides that model; apply the override with the host's per-invocation model selector when supported. If neither a named agent nor an explicit native model selector can honor it, report `decision_unavailable`. Do not inherit a more expensive parent model or silently execute a legacy automatic choice. Omitting `--host` retains the generic `cheapest_available` policy for other hosts; that value is a policy, not automatic price discovery.
- Respect host restrictions on subagents. A `subagent_required` packet is a handoff, not evidence that a subagent ran. No API key needs to be installed for fallback.

| Current host | Native agent definition (repository root) | Default model |
|---|---|---|
| Antigravity | `.agents/agents/bench-decider.md` | `flash` tier |
| Codex | `.codex/agents/bench-decider.toml` | `gpt-6-luna`, low effort |
| Claude Code | `.claude/agents/bench-decider.md` | `haiku` |

Invoke the named agent through the current host's native subagent tool, supplying the helper's `request` as its entire task. Codex model overrides require a fresh context (`fork_turns="none"` where supported); do not fork the parent's full conversation. For Claude Code, explicitly select the packet's model at invocation so a host-wide default cannot change it. Antigravity's agent definition fixes the `flash` tier. Confirm the actual model in host execution metadata; if the host substitutes a different model, report `decision_unavailable` rather than treating the requested model as the one used.

These definitions are project-scoped. When using the linked Skill from another workspace and `bench-decider` is not discovered, read the matching definition from this repository and invoke an equivalent fresh native subagent with its explicit model and instructions. Antigravity can use `define_subagent`; Codex and Claude Code can use their per-invocation model selector. If unsupported, stop at `decision_unavailable`. Do not create a separate CLI process, worktree, or recursively delegated Router task for this short decision.

## Decision flow

1. Get the task and `wiki facets` vocabulary. Reuse the vocabulary within the conversation while `wiki_hash` is unchanged. Automatic rules and explicit tags take precedence; ask the decision provider only about facets still requiring semantic judgment. Send the existing task summary, relevant requirements and context filenames; if insufficient, include the needed original prompt rather than guessing from a truncated summary. Finalize task facet tags before `evaluate`; preserve the original prompt and requirements.
2. For facets, create a request with one `noul` question per relevant allowed facet. Multiple facets may fit. Include short descriptions and boundary cases in the questions; model IDs and benchmark IDs alone do not explain their meaning. Treat uncertain answers as unresolved, not absent. Retain baseline candidates or ask the caller when a required facet cannot be established.
   - Ask in one batched call. Skip `rule:always` facets, facets a rule already set, and `rule:script(...)` language facets (script detection is decisive). Still ask other rule facets, because file-extension and keyword rules miss cases such as a React request without context files.
   - Tag a facet when its `noul` is at least 0.8. Append these boundary cases to the matching questions; without them, a cheap model tags almost every prompt as instruction following:
     - `task:instruction_following`: 1 only if the main challenge is obeying explicit output constraints (exact length, count, ordering, format, forbidden words); 0 for ordinary tasks that merely state requirements.
     - `difficulty:hard_prompts`: most routine coding, writing, or lookup tasks are 0, even when well specified.
     - `domain:software_it`: 1 only if the subject matter is software or IT itself; 0 when code is merely a tool for another subject.
     - `task:math`: 1 only if the main work is mathematical derivation or calculation, not incidental arithmetic. `domain:mathematical`: 1 only if the subject matter is mathematics.
     - `task:ocr_parse`: 1 only if the input is a scanned or photographed document whose text must be converted to structured output. `task:vision_ocr`: 1 only if an image is attached and the answer comes from text inside that image.
   - Measured on 60 labeled prompts with Jev (`eval/retrieval.py`, `eval/results/retrieval-jev1.md`): facet F1 0.89 and hallucinated-facet rate 0.12, against F1 0.53 for rules alone. About 2.4k input tokens per task.
3. Obtain `evaluate` and `evidence --format table` results. Only `eligible` profile IDs can be choices. With none, return `no_eligible_profile`; a single eligible profile needs no selection call. For several candidates, give the provider the task, relevant benchmark results, measured effort, missing/stale flags, and code-computed cost estimates. Ask one `choice` question with profile IDs plus `abstain`; express the task's quality/cost preference explicitly. Do not ask the model to calculate budgets, compare timestamps, invent missing scores, or treat a model's different-effort result as an exact profile measurement.
4. Invoke `python scripts/decide.py --host HOST --request REQUEST.json` using the current host from the table above. For `subagent_required`, invoke that host's native `bench-decider` as described above. Require `{"answers": {"QUESTION_ID": {"type": "choice", "choice": "ALLOWED_ID"}}}` or `{"type": "noul", "noul": 0.0}` for each answer. The IDs, types, and values must correspond to the request. Validate its saved reply with `python scripts/decide.py --host HOST --request REQUEST.json --response REPLY.json` before using it. The helper's `model` identifies the requested model; record the actual model from host metadata separately.
5. A confidence value is a signal, not an observed success rate. Subagent confidence is self-reported. For abstention, uncertain answers, or insufficient benchmark evidence, return to the caller rather than guessing a profile. Choose thresholds from representative task results; never use a probability as a new benchmark score.
6. Build the existing selection record from the validated profile ID and current `assessment_digest`, with policy ID `bench-router-jev` or `bench-router-cheap-subagent`. Generate a short factual `reason` from selected evidence IDs and policy; neither Jev nor a cheap subagent needs to write an essay. Record model/version, facets, wiki/snapshot hashes, selected unit IDs and supplied answers alongside the selection. Recheck this evidence provenance before dispatch: the existing assessment digest does not include Wiki/facet evidence. If it changed, repeat the decision. Run normal `route --selection` with the same task/context; Router rechecks constraints and availability.

Request example (both backends use the same shape):

```json
{"state": "Implement a React dashboard with routing and shared state.",
 "questions": {"webdev_react": {
   "type": "noul",
   "instructions": "Does the requested deliverable require a multi-file React web application, including component structure or shared state?"
 }}}
```

Batch independent facet questions into one call. The final profile choice follows local evidence retrieval, so it may need a second call. Keep common benchmark details and all-missing rows summarized; expand them when relevant. Persist full evidence locally and give the parent only the decision, provenance, and unresolved issues. These provider calls belong to this Skill workflow; plain `route` keeps its existing offline automatic policy.

Official Jev request/response reference: <https://docs.typesafe.ai/api>. Model IDs and prices: <https://docs.typesafe.ai/models>.
